rows.note: Use this about a person judged stupid or slow to understand.

example.english: You’re so dense, you can’t even answer such a simple question.
example.traditional: 你咁蠢，咁簡單都唔識答。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 ceon2 gam3 gaan2 daan1 dou1 m4 sik1 daap3

rows.note: Use this for explicitly high physical or measured density, rather than visual crowding.

example.english: This metal is dense, so it feels very heavy in the hand.
example.traditional: 呢種金屬密度高，所以拎上手好重。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 gam1 suk6 mat6 dou6 gou1 so2 ji5 ling1 soeng5 sau2 hou2 zung6

rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when writing, speech, or an explanation is hard to understand.

example.english: This contract is too dense to understand.
example.traditional: 呢份合約寫得太難明喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 se2 dak1 taai3 naan4 ming4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for many visible items packed closely together, rather than a measured density.

example.english: The page is covered in dense writing.
example.traditional: 張紙寫滿密密麻麻嘅字。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi2 se2 mun5 mat6 mat6 maa4 maa4 ge3 zi6
